## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/fields/src/widgets/nativeDateValue.ts` (`toDateTimeInputValue` / `fromDateTimeInputValue` on objectui `origin/main` `d999617`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the editable date-time face rolls an impossible stored day to a real one and a save can write it back. This is a new branch of objectui#10026's direction A (ruling `5749269396`: 「a silently wrong day is the failure North Star rule 4 forbids」), so the parent ruling is reused and nothing new is escalated. Data can change silently ⇒ p2.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T08:49Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main` `d999617`. Dedupe by this seat over 739 objectui cards (open, plus closed since 2026-09-18): `toDateTimeInputValue` → 1 hit (this card).

### Execution notes (direction inherited)

1. ⛔ Never roll, and ⛔ never blank silently (objectui#3127's shape): show the stored string with an invalid marker, or refuse the edit loudly — the taker measures which a `datetime-local` control allows.
2. If neither is possible in that control, stop and report on this card: that is the only fork.
3. Pin: a stored impossible day (30 February, with a time and a UTC `Z` suffix) is never shown or saved as 2 March.

Claim: PM loop round 7 (serial shift)

Container & model: `S`–`M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default judgement tier; `dispatch-gates.mjs` refuses objectui, so gates are hand-derived from objectui's own manifests and workflows)
Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5829614553
Serial constraints cleared: open PR file lists read 2026-09-25T08:52Z: none touches `nativeDateValue.ts`, `DateTimeField` or the grid's datetime cell. The parent PR objectui#10459 (objectui#10301) has merged.

Ruling-ref: inherited branch of objectui#10026 direction A (`5749269396`: 「a silently wrong day is the failure North Star rule 4 forbids」), as triage recorded (`5829614553`). ⛔ Never roll, ⛔ never blank silently. The one pre-declared fork: if a `datetime-local` control can neither show the stored string with an invalid marker nor refuse the edit loudly, the dev stops and reports it here. Why `Clause-②: no`: the editor stops rolling an impossible day into a real one; no accept-set widens and no public surface grows.

## ✅ ACCEPTED — PR objectui#10566 at `e58e47294`

`domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`, 2026-09-25T09:15Z. Reviewed against the dev report (comment 5829905149) and the diff on the PR head. `Clause-②: no` is confirmed.

**The inherited direction (objectui#10026 A, `5749269396`, via triage `5829614553`) holds: never roll, never blank silently.**
- `isImpossibleStoredDay` in `nativeDateValue.ts` judges the leading `YYYY-MM-DD` as written, through core's `isRealCalendarDate` (the read faces' one judgement), before any `new Date(...)`. It covers the `Z`, offset, zone-less and date-only spellings.
- `toDateTimeInputValue` hands the control `""` for such a day. `fromDateTimeInputValue` returns it untouched instead of the rolled ISO.
- The editable `DateTimeField` and the grid's editable datetime cell mark the control `aria-invalid` and render a notice naming the stored string, linked through `aria-describedby` (new key `fields.dateTime.impossibleDay`, in all 10 packs).
- Nothing is written until the user picks a value.

**The fork was measured, not assumed.** Chromium 141 sanitises a nonexistent day in `datetime-local` (every spelling) to `""`, so the control itself cannot show the stored string. The string plus the invalid marker beside the control is possible, so the triage's first branch is taken and this is ⛔ not `needs_decision`.

**Pins run the real widget in UTC and in `America/Los_Angeles`:**
- a stored 30 February value with a time and a `Z` suffix never shows or saves 2 March;
- an untouched save writes nothing;
- an explicit pick writes the pick;
- real values round-trip unchanged.

Reverse-verified: with the guard made dead code, 16 red, and the 6 controls and explicit-pick cases stay green.

**Accepted deviations:**
- The changeset also declares `@object-ui/i18n` `patch`, because the locale packs are published source.
- The `de` quote-pairing count ratchet goes 63 → 64 for the new `de` string, with a dated rationale line.

**Gates.** fields and i18n tests pass (i18n 1178). Type-check exits 0 for both packages. Lint on 19 touched files shows 0 errors. The i18n drift, keys and dead-keys checks, and the changeset, line-citation and control-byte checks, all exit 0. The eager-locale check is left to CI. Trailers are model-free and the PR assignee is set.

**Out-of-scope finding, filed:** objectui#10567. The date-ONLY editor blanks an impossible stored day silently, because `input type=date` sanitises it to empty. It is the sibling half of this card, and objectui#10566 lands the face it needs.

Next: ready + auto-merge once CI is green on the head.
